explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: a simple circuit. Look at the battery, the positive end and the wire. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
The battery is the push. Its voltage shoves electrons out of its negative end, round the loop and back into its positive end; the electrons are not used up, only their energy is.

faq.q: What does the battery do in a circuit?
faq.a: The battery is the push. Its chemicals give it a voltage, a kind of electrical pressure that drives electrons from its negative end, through the wires and the bulb, and back to its positive end.
asks: Why do you need a battery?

faq.q: Why do circuits use copper wires?
faq.a: Copper is a good conductor: its atoms have loose outer electrons that drift along easily. The plastic coating is an insulator that keeps the current inside the wire and your fingers safe.

faq.q: What does a switch do in a circuit?
faq.a: A switch is a movable metal bridge. Closed, it completes the loop so current flows; open, it leaves an air gap, and air does not conduct, so everything stops.
asks: How does a switch turn a bulb on?

faq.q: How does the bulb make light?
faq.a: The current squeezes through a very thin wire called the filament. The electrons bump into its atoms and heat it to about 2500 degrees Celsius, so it glows white-hot.

faq.q: Why must a circuit be a complete loop?
faq.a: Electrons are not used up; they travel round and round. If there is a gap anywhere, the ones behind it have nowhere to go, so the whole flow stops at once.
asks: What happens if there is a gap in the circuit?

facts: Electric current is measured in amperes, or amps, named after Andre-Marie Ampere.
A standard AA battery gives about 1.5 volts.

quiz.say: What happens if you open the switch in a simple circuit?
quiz.show: What happens if you open the switch in a simple circuit?
quiz.why: Opening the switch leaves an air gap, so the loop is broken and no current can flow anywhere in it.

wrong.1: A gap cannot add push; it stops the flow completely.
wrong.2: Current flows round the whole loop or not at all.
